summary: The retrieved documents describe a framework for handling agreements within a web application using ASP.NET and C#. The documents include details about user interactions with agreements, UI components, and system processes that manage agreements and their templates.
purpose: The purpose of the documents is to manage and display agreements and their related templates within an ASP.NET web application. It provides mechanisms to handle user interactions, data binding, and dynamic content display.
